---
title: "RCT outcome repository"
---

Indicators rarely need to be built from scratch. Managing Authorities should draw on existing, well-tested measures from comparable evaluations before designing new ones. Validated frameworks such as the Community Innovation Survey, the World Bank Enterprise Surveys, or the OECD Oslo Manual provide internationally comparable definitions and question formats that have been tested across many contexts. Using them improves the quality of your data and makes findings easier to compare with evidence from other programmes and regions.

The RCT outcome repository provides a curated, searchable list of outcome indicators drawn from validated instruments, organised by topic. For each outcome you will find:

- The outcome name and a plain-language definition
- The metric - how to operationalise and measure it

**Tip:** not all outcomes are appropriate for all evaluations. Select outcomes that match the specific instrument you are evaluating and the causal chain in your Theory of Change. The data source column will help you decide whether to collect the outcome through a survey or retrieve it from administrative records.
